name: Detune Doubler
description: Twelve cents up mixed with the dry signal at the heel and the toe alike: a thickening, chorus-like double.

name: Dive Bomb
description: Heel at unison, toe two octaves down, with a little glide: stomp it for a dive like a tremolo arm's.

name: Fifth Harmony
description: A fifth above, mixed with the dry signal: parallel harmony from the toe, unison at the heel.

name: Octave Down
description: Heel at unison, toe an octave down: a bass line under a riff, or a low tuning without retuning.

name: Octave Up Lead
description: Heel at unison, toe an octave up: rock the pedal for the classic screaming octave sweep.

name: Two Octaves Up
description: Heel at unison, toe two octaves up, for the shrieking top of a solo.
